explains: The copy of the spec the web client was generated from, api/openapi.json, is truncated by a bad download (it is not JSON), and InvoiceDetailPage changes in the same commit. In the web repository the change is read as usual: the page is mounted at /invoices/:invoiceId. The http edge to the api cannot be followed: which operations the generated client has comes from that spec, so which routes the page calls was not established. The spec is unreadable (blocking) and so is the edge (blocking); no http edge is made and nothing is said about routes being called or not called. The propagation says it is not complete.

must_exclude.why: the spec the calls are read from cannot be read, so no call is matched to an operation
